g.text: writes atomically; moves a corrupt file aside
«Facade» api.main: one REST surface over the active
session, the scenarios and the incident history.
«Middleware» /api/<path> is served as /<path>, so one UI
build works behind the Vite proxy and in the container.
«DTO» pydantic request models validate every body
(ranges, required fields) and return 422 when invalid.
«Repository» storage behind interfaces: scenarios in memory;
incident history in a JSON file (in memory during tests).
PostgreSQL from the Part B plan is not built.
«Memento» Snapshot records the tick and cell states.
Grey class: defined in the engine-core diagram.
